description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the usage of custom fonts (Typefaces) in drawing text on a Canvas. It loads a custom font from assets and displays sample text with default and custom fonts.

classes.name: Typefaces
classes.description: An activity class that displays sample text with default and custom fonts.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View that handles drawing sample text with different fonts on the Canvas.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that loads the custom typeface and sets up the paint object.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render text with default and custom fonts on the Canvas.
